facts.fact: e-Shram is a central Aadhaar-seeded database of unorganised workers, used to deliver social security benefits to them (it is not itself a cash benefit)
facts.quote: It is envisaged that this portal will be used to facilitate delivery of various social security benefits to unorganised workers.

facts.fact: Through the e-Shram One-Stop-Solution a worker can enrol in and track the integrated schemes with one UAN, without visiting separate portals
facts.quote: Tracking of all integrated schemes through a unique identifier i.e., UAN. No need to visit multiple portals or fill out separate forms for each scheme.

facts.fact: Schemes available through e-Shram include One Nation One Ration Card and the PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan pension scheme, among others
facts.quote: The following schemes are currently available under eShram OSS: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)

facts.fact: In emergencies and pandemic-like situations the database may be used to give assistance to eligible unorganised workers
facts.quote: In emergency and national pandemic like situations, this database may be utilised to provide necessary assistance to the eligible unorganised workers.

behaviour: Gives the e-Shram benefits as stated on labour.gov.in / eshram.gov.in, in Hindi, with citation; no invented cash benefit.
fail_if: It says the e-Shram card itself pays a fixed cash amount or monthly allowance, or invents a benefit not on the official page.
summary: Added from the eShram FAQs: Aadhaar-seeded database to deliver social security, One-Stop-Solution with one UAN, integrated schemes (ONORC, PM-SYM, etc.), emergency assistance; no cash benefit.
